remarks_1999: Abiquiú Notebooks notes inscription 1 and indicates, 'Back: Georgia O'Keeffe☆ {5-point star} on backing'[not verified]. Pictured in 1933 New York (An American Place) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 55. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks associate work with no. 2, *White Flower #1* [cat. no. 815] in this exhibition, but photograph indicates that it was no. 10. Reproduced and titled *White Trumpet Flower* in *America & Alfred Stieglitz* (1934); reproduced in *Wings* (December 1934); *Trumpet White Flower* in *Delphian Quarterly* (April 1945); reproduced in *Time* (May 1946). (Source: Lynes, 1999)
